title: Research Agenda Update: R29 LLM Filter Design Correction + R28 3-Agent Architecture
rationale: Synthesize today's research into the research agenda section of MEMORY.md. Key corrections: (1) R29 LLM filter should be a top-K re-ranking approach, not binary threshold. (2) R28 EarningsQualityAgent now has validated exact prompts from arXiv:2603.20965. (3) R33 concept now has a concrete architecture reference (FactorEngine). (4) AlphaForgeBench confirms LLM-as-factor-generator boundary.
content:
## Research Agenda Update (2026-04-11 Dream Cycle)

- **Round 28** — TradingAgents multi-agent overlay on PEAD — QUEUED (next to run)
  - **AMENDMENT (2026-04-11)**: EarningsQualityAgent should use 3-agent zero-shot architecture:
    - Performance Agent (Qwen2.5-3B): realized earnings/revenue/margins focus
    - Guidance Agent (Llama-3.2-3B): forward outlook/guidance revisions focus
    - Risk Agent (Qwen2.5-72B): litigation/regulation/liquidity/disruption focus
    - Meta-classifier: L2-regularized logistic regression on (label, confidence, agreement) features
    - All prompts include anti-extrapolation instruction prefix
    - Use cross-agent DISAGREEMENT as PEAD failure signal: Performance+/Guidance- = 'beat but lowered guidance'
  - Source: arXiv:2603.20965 (validated on 18,420 disclosures; 0.561 → 0.612 balanced accuracy)

- **Round 29** — LLM semantic filter on equity pairs trading — NEXT QUEUED (R28 runs first)
  - **DESIGN CORRECTION (2026-04-11)**: Use TOP-K RE-RANKING, not binary threshold:
    - Run LLM on top K=100 pairs by statistical rank → trade top M=20 by LLM score
    - LLM output JSON: {"mechanism_strength": 0-100, "expected_co_movement_sign": +1 or -1}
    - VETO if co_movement_sign conflicts with observed spread direction
    - Replace old 'skip if score < 40' with 'rank all, trade top 20, veto on sign conflict'
  - Full pipeline (unchanged): factor residualize → SPONGEsym cluster → SAE cluster → cointegration → LLM re-rank → Kelly trade

- **Round 31** — Text-based PEAD (FinBERT + 3-day confirmation) — QUEUED

- **Round 32** — SPX put-writing with VIX-Kelly hybrid sizing — QUEUED (independent)

- **Round 33** (concept) — FactorEngine-style LLM-guided factor mining on US equities
  - Seed with 146 harness strategies + SSRN abstracts as knowledge base
  - Separate LLM (logic search) from Bayesian (parameter tuning) per FactorEngine design
  - Reference: arXiv:2603.16365 (Sharpe 1.0093, +126% excess return on CSI300)
